title: Zero penetration must not hide garment metric damage or stale body contact
precondition: A rest metric or equivalent stretch/bend constraints are versioned
The current body mesh and pose are versioned
A body SDF or equivalent signed-distance query is versioned

knownBadControls.name: projection-only
knownBadControls.expectedFailure: penetration may be zero while mean/max edge strain exceeds the task contract

knownBadControls.name: stale-body-pose-sdf
knownBadControls.expectedFailure: cloth can satisfy the stale collider yet penetrate the current body

gate: All mesh/pose/SDF/rest-metric identities resolve to the current candidate
Penetration and metric error both meet task-specific thresholds
Thresholds are declared by the task contract; N279 smoke thresholds are not production defaults

replay.observation: joint distance/contact solve removed penetration and cut mean absolute edge strain from 0.2455196050 to 0.0010869290; stale collider left 18 current-body penetrations

scopeBoundary: Does not validate garment patterns, sewing, material calibration, self-collision, animated-body SDF updates, production performance, visual acceptance, or user acceptance.
